summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.

verdict.line: Buy the Alienware AW3225DM if you want a large curved screen that works for both PC and console gaming, thanks to its QHD resolution and 180 Hz refresh at a budget‑friendly $319. The catch is the lack of a 3.5 mm headphone jack.
